item.title: TSURUGIHIME launches in Early Access in 2026
item.description: Side-scrolling action RPG TSURUGIHIME will launch in Early Access for PC via Steam in 2026, developer Fahrenheit 213 announced.

item.title: Dead Format launches December 10
item.description: Survival horror game Dead Format will launch for PC via Steam on December 10, publisher Oro Interactive and developer Katanalevy announced.

item.title: Keep Digging version 2.0 update announced
item.description: Wild Dog has announced the version 2.0 update for multiplayer exploration game Keep Digging. It will launch this winter.

item.title: Flotsam launches December 5
item.description: Floating city builder Flotsam will leave Early Access and launch for PC via Steam and GOG on December 5, Stray Fawn Publishing and developer Pajama Llama Games announced.

item.title: Into the Fire launches in Early Access in 2026
item.description: Anti-combat action adventure RPG Into the Fire will launch in Early Access for PC via Steam and GOG in 2026, developer Starward Industries announced. A playtest is coming “soon.”
